faqs.question: What is the all-in pricing at Oak Trail?
faqs.answer: Every listed price includes base rent plus required monthly fees like water, sewer, trash, pest control, valet trash, and package lockers. There are no surprise line items at lease signing.

faqs.question: Are pets allowed at Oak Trail?
faqs.answer: Yes, Oak Trail is a pet-friendly community with an on-site dog park designed for off-leash play. Breed restrictions, pet deposits, and monthly pet rent are quoted in writing at application.

faqs.question: What floor plans are available?
faqs.answer: Oak Trail offers seven floor plans ranging from one-bedroom to three-bedroom layouts, between 678 and 1,380 square feet. Prices start at $1,512 per month all-in.

faqs.question: How far is Oak Trail from Cherry Creek State Park?
faqs.answer: Oak Trail is approximately 10 minutes from Cherry Creek State Park and 15 minutes from the Cherry Creek Shopping Center, placing you near both nature and retail.

faqs.question: What amenities does Oak Trail offer?
faqs.answer: Community amenities include two resort-style swimming pools, a 24-hour fitness center with yoga studio, an on-site dog park, resident clubhouse, business center, and outdoor social spaces with grilling areas.

faqs.question: Is there a move-in special?
faqs.answer: Select floor plans currently offer up to two months free. Contact the leasing office or schedule a tour to learn which plans are eligible for the current promotion.

faqs.question: Do apartments include in-unit laundry?
faqs.answer: Yes, every home at Oak Trail includes an in-home washer and dryer set, along with granite countertops and private balconies or patios.

faqs.question: What utilities are included in the rent?
faqs.answer: Water, sewer, trash, pest control, valet trash, and package lockers are included in the all-in price. Electricity and internet are billed separately by your chosen provider.
